sections.title: Know your regulars by name, not by spreadsheet.
sections.lead: Everyone who’s booked, checked in or been imported, in one list, with every event they came to. {{brand.name}} sorts them into groups you can act on: first-timers to bring back, regulars to thank, lapsed regulars to miss.

sections.title: Every group says how it was worked out.
sections.lead: No scores, no guesses. Each group has a plain rule, and it updates as people book and check in.

items.title: First-timers
items.body: Came once. The best moment to invite them back is the week after.
items.then: Checked in at exactly one event

items.title: Regulars
items.body: The people your nights are built on.
items.then: 3 or more events in the last 180 days

items.title: Lapsed regulars
items.body: Used to come, haven’t lately. Worth a personal message.
items.then: 2 or more events, no check-in for 90 days

items.title: Advocates
items.body: They bring people. Their link brought someone who booked or came.
items.then: At least one person through their link

items.title: Reliable attendees
items.body: Book and show up. First in line when you have one seat.
items.then: 80% or more of at least 3 bookings checked in

items.title: Reachable on WhatsApp
items.body: Said yes to hearing from you on WhatsApp.
items.then: Opted in, with a phone number

items.title: Frequent non-members
items.body: Come often but haven’t joined. The people to tell about your membership.
items.then: 4 or more events in 60 days, not a member

items.title: New to you
items.body: On your list, but hasn’t been to one of your events yet.

sections.title: Your list belongs to you. Their data belongs to them.
sections.lead: Export your contacts whenever you want. When a guest asks to be forgotten or to stop hearing from you, {{brand.name}} handles it and keeps a record.

items.title: Groups stay private
items.body: Guests never see which groups they’re in.

items.question: Does it work if guests didn’t book on {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: Yes. Import guest lists from a CSV or Excel file, or bring in a Luma guest list if you’re on Luma Plus, and check-ins at your door count the same. Groups are worked out from who actually came.

items.question: How are regulars worked out?
items.answer: Three or more events checked in over the last 180 days. Every group shows its rule, so you know why someone is in it.

items.question: Can my team see the records?
items.answer: Owners and managers on your team can. Door staff only see the list for their event.

items.question: Can I add notes about a guest?
items.answer: Yes. Notes are private to you and your team, and never shown to the guest.

items.question: Can I export my list?
items.answer: Yes, whenever you like: export your contacts as a file.
